review_candidates.description: About Us When you work at Chugach Government Solutions (CGS), you join a proud legacy of supporting missions while sustaining culture. The federal division of Chugach Alaska Corporation, CGS has been supporting critical missions as a government contractor for over 25 years. Our focus is to support facility maintenance, IT/technical services, construction and education. We are proud to have built, and continue to foster, an incredibly talented team spanning across the globe in hundreds of different fields - each team member proud to serve our country with first-class business services, while also making a difference for our Chugach shareholders. At CGS, empowering employees is a part of our core, and that focus is one of the ways we build and foster high-performing teams. We empower our employees through competitive compensation and benefits package, professional growth opportunities, truthful communication, and more! If you are looking for an opportunity to serve something bigger than yourself; if you want your day job to be one that creates meaningful value; if you are looking for an environment that highly values employees and respects individual differences - then Chugach Government Solutions may be the right fit for you! Position Location This position is remote with travel when necessary. Job Overview The Director, Price to Win (PTW) is responsible for developing independent, data-driven Price-to-Win assessments that inform capture strategy for large and complex Government pursuits. The role focuses on market intelligence, customer affordability, competitor behavior, historical award analysis, and quantitative modeling to establish recommended competitive price ranges and strategic trade-space for executive and pursuit-team decision making. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience supporting large-scale Base Operations, Facilities Services, or similarly complex Government services pursuits and will be able to translate fragmented market, customer, competitor, and cost information into actionable recommendations for senior leadership. The Director, Price to Win will report to the Chief Financial Officer or other designated executive leader and will have an independent advisory voice in collaboration with Business Development, Capture, Proposal, Pricing/Estimating, Finance, and Operations on large and complex Government pursuits. Responsibilities Essential Job Duties: Lead independent Price-to-Win analyses for priority pursuits, beginning during pipeline development and early capture and continuing through proposal strategy as appropriate. Collect, validate, and analyze competitive intelligence regarding customers, incumbents, likely competitors, market conditions, acquisition strategies, procurement histories, and award patterns. Assess customer affordability, available funding, budget trends, historical spend, procurement behavior, and other indicators to develop defensible target-price ranges. Develop competitor-specific pricing hypotheses and models using publicly available information, historical awards, labor-market data, contract structures, known business practices, and other relevant intelligence. Perform should-price and price-sensitivity analyses to identify the range in which a proposed solution is likely to remain both competitive and financially viable. Use quantitative methods, including scenario analysis, probability distributions, Monte Carlo simulation, and other analytical techniques, where appropriate, to evaluate uncertainty and competitive price ranges. Identify and communicate the primary cost and price drivers that are most likely to influence customer evaluation, competitor behavior, and overall win probability. Analyze RFP pricing structures and Government evaluation methodologies to understand how price is likely to be evaluated and where competitive differentiation may exist. Partner with Business Development, Capture, Operations, Solutioning, Pricing/Estimating, Contracts, and Finance to understand the proposed solution and test its competitive positioning. Review cost estimates and pricing scenarios developed by the Pricing/Estimating function as inputs to PTW analysis; assess how those outputs compare with independent market and competitor intelligence. Develop executive-level PTW briefings that clearly communicate assumptions, confidence levels, competitive risks, price ranges, tradeoffs, and recommended actions. Provide an independent strategic recommendation to capture and executive leadership regarding the price position most likely to support the company's win strategy while maintaining appropriate business objectives. Support competitive assessments, black-hat reviews, capture reviews, and other pursuit strategy sessions by providing fact-based competitor and pricing intelligence. Build and maintain reusable competitive-intelligence resources, historical award data, market benchmarks, and PTW analytical tools to improve future pursuit decisions. Document key assumptions, sources, methodologies, and limitations supporting PTW recommendations to enable repeatability, transparency, and lessons learned. Conduct post-award analyses comparing PTW assumptions and recommendations with actual award outcomes and competitor information, where available, and refine methodologies accordingly. Provide guidance and thought leadership on PTW methodology, competitive analysis, and market-intelligence practices across the organization. Perform additional duties consistent with the strategic PTW and competitive-intelligence function as required. Job Requirements Mandatory Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, Construction Management, or a related field; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered consistent with Company practice. Fifteen (15) or more years of progressively responsible experience in Government contracting, capture, competitive pricing, estimating, financial analysis, or related business-winning functions, including substantial hands-on experience performing strategic Price-to-Win or competitive-price analysis. Strong quantitative, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to draw conclusions from incomplete or imperfect market information. Demonstrated ability to develop Price-to-Win assessments, competitive-price ranges, competitor models, customer affordability assessments, or comparable strategic pricing analyses. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with analytical/modeling tools used for scenario analysis, probability analysis, or pricing intelligence. Ability to distinguish between cost estimating and market-based competitive pricing analysis and to challenge assumptions constructively. Strong understanding of Government acquisition strategies, contract types, source-selection approaches, and the role of price in competitive procurements. Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS and Government proposal processes sufficient to interpret acquisition requirements and pricing/evaluation structures. Ability to synthesize complex information into concise, decision-ready recommendations for senior leaders. Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present conclusions, assumptions, uncertainty, and risk to executive and pursuit teams. Ability to work independently across multiple pursuits and collaborate effectively with Business Development, Capture, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Contracts, and Proposal teams. Preferred Demonstrated experience supporting large, complex Government services pursuits; Base Operations, Facilities Services, logistics, infrastructure, or comparable service environments. Experience working with tribally owned, Alaska Native Corporation, 8(a), or other Government-contracting business structures. Formal training in Price to Win, competitive assessment, capture management, or business development (for example, Shipley, APMP, or comparable training). Trabajarás en la intersección de Sales, Marketing y RevOps, combinando research profundo, multi-threading y messaging de alto impacto (map → research → multi-thread → engage → qualify → handoff). Este rol requiere a alguien estratégico pero ejecutor, con la capacidad de pensar como un AE pero operar con la velocidad y disciplina de un hunter. Alguien que entienda que abrir un banco tier-1 requiere un plan de cuenta, no un blast de emails. 1. Strategic Account Mapping & Research Serás dueño de construir la inteligencia de cuenta que hace posible cada conversación. Mapear el landscape enterprise de los mercados target de Jelou: identificar las top 100–200 cuentas estratégicas por vertical (banca, seguros, retail, fintech) y mercado (México, Colombia, Ecuador, Perú, Chile) Construir account plans para cuentas Tier 1: org chart, iniciativas estratégicas, tech stack actual, pain points identificados, presupuesto de transformación digital, competencia instalada Identificar el buying committee en cada cuenta: sponsor económico, champion técnico, usuario final, influenciadores y blockers. Mapear relaciones de poder Monitorear triggers de negocio: cambios regulatorios, lanzamientos de banca digital, contrataciones clave, earnings calls, RFPs públicos, noticias de transformación digital Mantener y enriquecer la base de cuentas en HubSpot con datos accionables que permitan priorización inteligente 2. Outbound Estratégico & ABM Execution Ejecutarás campañas de outreach diseñadas para penetrar cuentas complejas, no para hacer volumen. Diseñar y ejecutar plays de ABM 1:1 y 1:few por cuenta estratégica: secuencias personalizadas para cada stakeholder dentro del buying committee Ejecutar multi-threading: contactar múltiples personas dentro de la misma cuenta simultáneamente para construir presión interna y generar conversaciones Crear mensajes hyper-personalizados basados en research profundo: referencia a iniciativas específicas del prospect, métricas públicas, pain points de la industria y casos de uso relevantes de Jelou Orquestar secuencias multicanal sofisticadas: email ejecutivo, InMail, contenido personalizado, warm calls, eventos virtuales, notas de voz, video personalizado Coordinar con Marketing en la creación de assets personalizados para cuentas Tier 1: one-pagers, business cases por vertical, invitaciones a executive dinners Gestionar un volumen controlado de actividad: calidad sobre cantidad. 30–50 touchpoints estratégicos/día en cuentas priorizadas 3. Multi-threading & Stakeholder Navigation Serás experto en navegar organizaciones complejas y crear múltiples puntos de entrada. Desarrollar relaciones con múltiples stakeholders simultáneamente: C-level, VPs, Directors y mandos medios operacionales Adaptar el narrative de Jelou por persona: ROI y reducción de costos para el CFO, innovación y competitividad para el CEO, capacidades técnicas para el CTO, eficiencia operacional para el VP Ops Identificar y cultivar champions internos: personas dentro de la organización que pueden vender Jelou internamente Coordinar con AEs para diseñar la estrategia de cuenta conjunta antes del handoff formal 4. Qualification & Strategic Handoff Serás el filtro estratégico que asegura que los AEs reciban oportunidades con información profunda y contexto completo. Calificar oportunidades usando un framework adaptado (MEDDPICC): Métricas, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain, Champion, Competition Ejecutar discovery calls de 20–30 min con profundidad estratégica: entender la cadena de valor del prospect, volúmenes de transacciones, canales digitales actuales, presupuesto asignado y timeline de decisión Documentar handoffs completos: brief al AE con mapa de stakeholders, pain points validados, competencia identificada, urgencia, proceso de compra y next steps acordados Participar en las primeras meetings con el AE cuando sea estratégico para mantener la continuidad de la relación 5. Market Intelligence & Colaboración Cross-Functional Serás la fuente de inteligencia de mercado enterprise para toda la organización. Compartir intelligence competitiva: qué vendors están instalados en cada cuenta, cómo posiciona la competencia, qué objeciones emergen por vertical Colaborar con Marketing en la estrategia de ABM: definir target account lists, co-crear contenido para campañas enterprise, feedback sobre messaging que resuena vs. lo que no Alimentar a Producto con insights de mercado: features que piden los enterprise, gaps vs. competencia, requerimientos regulatorios por vertical Participar en win/loss reviews con Sales para mejorar el approach en cuentas similares futuras Este rol es para ti si: Tienes 2–4 años de experiencia en BDR, SDR Enterprise, Inside Sales o roles similares vendiendo a cuentas grandes en B2B SaaS Track record demostrable abriendo cuentas enterprise complejas con deal sizes de $50K+ ARR Experiencia con ABM y multi-threading — has trabajado cuentas con múltiples stakeholders y ciclos de 3–9 meses Español nativo o near-native con inglés profesional (escrito y hablado). Portugués es un fuerte plus Experiencia hands-on con CRM (HubSpot preferido) y herramientas de ABM/prospecting (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Demandbase, 6sense, Clay o equivalentes) Pensador estratégico que puede construir un account plan y ejecutarlo con disciplina Cómodo trabajando en un ambiente startup fast-paced y remote-first en zonas horarias de LATAM Plus: Experiencia directa vendiendo a banca, seguros o retail enterprise en LATAM Conocimiento de IA conversacional, plataformas de chatbots o tecnología de contact center Curiosidad técnica profunda — puedes mantener una conversación inteligente con un CTO sobre APIs, integraciones y arquitectura Experiencia en organizaciones post-Serie A o Serie B en hipercrecimiento Has usado herramientas de IA para escalar research y personalización sin perder calidad Red de contactos existente en enterprise LATAM (servicios financieros, telecom, retail) Qué buscamos en esta persona Mentalidad de estratega-ejecutor: piensa como un AE, ejecuta como un hunter. Obsesión por el research: nunca contacta a alguien sin saber su contexto. La personalización no es meter el nombre en el subject — es entender el negocio. Multi-threader natural: piensa en cuentas, no en contactos individuales. Sabe que un deal enterprise se gana con 3–5 relaciones, no con 1. Data-informed: mide lo que importa, testea hipótesis y ajusta el approach basado en señales reales. Conectar personas con soluciones tecnológicas, sin fricción y de manera segura. ¿Cuál es nuestra visión? Conectar a personas con soluciones personalizadas en un solo lugar para toda Latinoamérica. Orquestamos a todas las organizaciones en un sólo lugar con un sistema multi IA; creando la tienda más grande de “Agentes IA” que unifica a todos los negocios de LATAM. Nuestros valores: We Challenge the Norm — Desafiamos lo establecido, somos disruptivos y no tenemos miedo de ser diferentes ni de pensar diferente. Evolve or die — Somos resilientes, nos movemos con rapidez y adaptabilidad, con un norte claro. Act, own it, make it happen — Nos remangamos las mangas; no esperamos instrucciones para actuar. Stay playful — Nos reímos, nos ayudamos y celebramos juntos. Rebels with a cause — Todo lo que hacemos busca algo más grande: eliminar la fricción del día a día de los que nos rodean.
